581)༄༅/gnas bsdus kyi sbyor ba sdig sgrib dag byed dbang gi skabs su rigs drug gnas 'dren spro na/dang po gsol gdab ni/kye ma mgon po thugs ra

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gnas bsdus kyi sbyor ba sdig sgrib dag byed dbang gi skabs su rigs drug gnas 'dren spro na/ dang po gsol gdab ni/ kye ma mgon po thugs rje can: rigs drug gnas su ltung ba yi: skyabs bral mgon med sems can la: thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol: chos bshad pa ni/ kye ma: tshe 'phos lus brjes bar do'i yid lus khyod: sngon chad ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: dug gsum gyis bcings ngan song gsum du mnar: deng nas brtsams te rgyal ba'i thugs rje yi: pho nyas bzung ste rigs drug gnas nas drangs: don 'bras 'dod phyir dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: 'dren pa thub chen drug la gsol ba thob: skyabs su gsol ba ni/ nyon drug gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: phyin drug chos thob nyon drug rnam par dag: rigs drug 582)thub pa rang rtags phyag rgya can: 'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol: bcom ldan thub pa drug la skyabs su mchi: phyag mtshan gyi dbang ni/ hūm̐: 'gro drug gnas las skyob pa'i phyir: thub drug phyag mtshan 'di rnams kyis: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rigs drug sdug bsngal bral bar shog: du da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: pre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: tri ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: su sarba du la sarba karma pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: a sarba ta thā ga ta bid+ya khat+ga tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa: bum dbang ni/ hūm̐: rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rigs drug skye sgo 583)bcad nas ni: zhing khams lnga la dbang bsgyur shog: hūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ swa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ āṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hā karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lan chags sbyong ba ni/

hūm̐: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das bu lon lan chags bsnyags pa yi: gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: rigs drug sa bon sreg pa ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang: nga rgyal log lta the tshom rnams: 'di dag 'jig rten dug yin te: kun bzang zhi khro dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi: nyon mongs 584) dri ma dag gyur cig: bag chags bkru ba ni/ 'di ni phyin drug rang bzhin chu: nyon mongs dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: phar phyin chu yis legs bkrus pas: nyon drug dri ma dag gyur cig: gnas nas drang ba ni/ sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: mtho ris thar pa'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob shog: rdo rjes phyir lam bcad do/ de nas dngos gzhi yon tan bskyed pa'i dbang la 'jug go maṅga lam//
